sources.excerpt: Least concern LC NT VU EN CR EW EX Least Concern Extinct Current Population Trend : Stable Beavers are famously busy, and they turn their talents to reengineering the landscape as few other animals can. Felling and gnawing trees with their strong teeth and powerful jaws, they create massive log, branch, and mud structures to block streams and turn fields and forests into the large ponds that beavers love. When sites are available, beavers burrow in the banks of rivers and lakes. But they also transform less suitable habitats by building dams. They are often strategically located in the middle of ponds and can only be reached by underwater entrances. Beavers are among the largest of rodents.
